# SEOLinkBuildings

> Guest-post and backlink marketplace connecting advertisers with verified publishers across Europe and major English-speaking markets. Official site: https://seolinkbuildings.com

## Brand
- Brand name: SEOLinkBuildings
- Domain: seolinkbuildings.com
- Product: two-sided marketplace for buying and selling editorial guest-post placements and backlinks
- Positioning: verified publishers, transparent EUR pricing, wallet checkout, live-URL order tracking

## Product
SEOLinkBuildings (seolinkbuildings.com) is a two-sided marketplace for buying and selling editorial guest-post placements. Advertisers browse a catalog of publisher sites, fund a EUR wallet, assign approved articles, and track orders to live URL. Publishers list sites, fulfil placement tasks, and withdraw earnings.

Public marketing site languages: English UK (default, unprefixed), English US (/us), German (/de), French (/fr), Dutch (/nl), Spanish (/es), Portuguese (/pt), Italian (/it), Polish (/pl), plus additional European locale prefixes (/at, /ch, /ro, /gr, /dk, /se, /no, /bg, /hu, /ee). Logged-in SaaS dashboard is English. Country guest-post landers (English URLs only) include Germany, UK, Italy, Spain, France, Netherlands, Switzerland, Austria, Romania, Greece, Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Bulgaria, Hungary, Estonia, and Poland.

The live canonical host is https://seolinkbuildings.com (www redirects to apex). Brand country-code domains 301 onto seolinkbuildings.com locale paths; they are not separate indexable sites.

## Key URLs
The indexable public pages and published blog posts are the sitemap. Account pages (`/login`, `/register`) stay out of the sitemap.
